subject: Post-demo: ownership playbook, stakeholder handoff & NDA routing
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Torres <elaine@edgehealth.com>, Jordan Smith <j.smith@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: ownership playbook, stakeholder handoff & NDA routing

Hi Elaine / Jordan — great demo today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a proposed ownership / routing plan so we don’t lose momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary business objective: reduce inference cost and latency on patient-facing triage flows (target 60% P50 latency reduction).
- Economic buyer: Elaine Torres (VP Product) — will sign off on budget and ROI case.
- Procurement & legal: Jordan (procurement lead) + Aaron (security) will need MSA/DPA review; Procurement prefers bundled MSA + SOW.

Immediate ask / gating items
1) NDA — EdgeHealth asked to get a mutual NDA in place before exchanging limited telemetry samples. I attached a first-pass mutual NDA (EdgeHealth_NDA_v1.docx).
2) Security materials — Aaron asked for SOC2 summary + data flow diagram; I linked our SOC2 pointer in the shared drive.
3) Commercials — Ben will send a compact rate card and pilot pricing options (2-week pilot, fixed token cap).

Proposed redline / routing sequence (to keep timelines tight)
- NDA (mutual): Redwood legal (Marcus) -> EdgeHealth legal -> sign (target 2 business days turn once on reviewer desks)
- DPA: dovetail with NDA review, security focused (target 3 business days)
- MSA + SOW: start parallel redlines after initial NDA agreement; procurement cycle typically 5–7 business days for our pilot SOW per previous customers.

Owners (proposed)
- Redwood commercial: Kimberly Park (owner) / Ben Carter (pricing)
- Redwood legal: Marcus Lin (primary reviewer)
- EdgeHealth: Jordan Smith (procurement) / Aaron Wu (security)

Next steps
- Ben: send pilot rate card & sample SOW by EOD tomorrow.
- Marcus: I shared the NDA draft attached — please add Redwood-line comments and I’ll forward to EdgeHealth.
- Elaine/Jordan: confirm procurement timeline and whether your legal prefers DocuSign or a redline docx exchange.

Attachments: EdgeHealth_NDA_v1.docx (docx)

Thanks — Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Solutions 
Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0199
From: Elaine Torres <elaine@edgehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: ownership playbook, stakeholder handoff & NDA routing

Thanks Kimberly — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: procurement is on a 2-week sprint for pilots this quarter; ideal NDA in 48–72 hours so we can exchange telemetry.
- Legal workflow: Jordan’s team prefers redline exchange via docx for NDAs (we typically do a docx -> redline -> docx cycle) and then DocuSign for signatures once final.
- Turn times: Legal typically targets 3 business days per document; procurement adds 1–2 days after legal for routing. If Redwood can do shorter turn-times on the NDA that helps.

Jordan — looping you to confirm the procurement owner and any additional compliance checklists we need to share. Aaron — can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts you require (summary report or full read-only link)?

—Elaine

Elaine Torres
VP Product, EdgeHealth
elaine@edgehealth.com | +1 617-555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-demo: ownership playbook, stakeholder handoff & NDA routing

Quick commercial packet and sequencing from my side — attaching a compact rate card and a marked-up NDA with Redwood comments. Key points: 

- Pilot offer: 2-week pilot, $3,500 flat fee + overage at our pilot per-token rate (outlined in attached PDF).
- Redline sequencing (recommended):
  1) NDA (mutual) — target 2 business days once both sides have reviewers on queue.
  2) DPA — review concurrent to NDA if EdgeHealth wants to start security review early (3 business days).
  3) MSA + SOW — start parallel drafting; final sign after commercial agreement (5–7 business days typical).

- Escalation path: If legal turn exceeds 5 business days for NDA, trigger commercial escalation to Kimberly + Redwood legal (Marcus) to request fast-track review.

Attachments: Redwood-rate-card-2028.pdf (pdf); EdgeHealth_NDA_v1_kp_comments.docx (docx)
